n = int(input())

# Function for modular exponentiation
def qpow(base, exp, mod=10**9+7):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

# Recursive DFS with memoization
id_map = {}
tt = 0
ch = {}
p = []
q = []

def dfs(s):
    global tt
    if s in id_map:
        return id_map[s]
    tt += 1
    id_map[s] = tt
    ch[tt] = {}
    for i in range(1 << n):
        t = s
        for j in range(1 << n):
            for k in range(n):
                if (j >> k) & 1 and (i >> k) & 1 and ((s >> (j ^ (1 << k))) & 1):
                    t |= 1 << j
        ch[tt][i] = dfs(t)
    return tt
